name: hourglass
description: Watch everything that can expire — TLS certificates, Linux passwords and accounts, database logins — and warn before the sand runs out.

targets.about: TLS certs to check: space-separated host:port and/or PEM paths, e.g. 'example.com:443 /etc/ssl/site.pem' (leave blank for none)

days.about: warn when anything is within this many days of expiring
